overview_description.description:
Captain Fresh is a freshwater fish and seafood supply chain platform. Captain Fresh is a B2B marketplace leveraging technology to deliver the fastest harvest-to-retail in the industry. The company focuses on aggregating the fragmented retail demand across the country and linking them to the small fishermen and farmers throughout the Indian coast.

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

about_short_description.short_description: Captain Fresh operates a fish and seafood supply chain platform to deliver a fast harvest-to-retail service.

product.name: FaaS ERP Suite
product.description: An ERP system designed for seafood factories to manage production from raw material procurement to dispatch with traceability and customizable workflows.

product.name: Optimus ERP Solution
product.description: An ERP platform for seafood distributors that manages orders, inventory, supplier relations, financials, and logistics with a mobile app for customer order tracking.

product.name: Smart Retail Management
product.description: A service for supermarket chains managing fish counters, covering inventory, butchery, pricing, and operations with trained staff and technology integration.

product.name: Potential Fishing Zones (PFZ) Tool
product.description: A tool providing historic and real-time data on fishing zones, ocean topography, weather, and navigation aids to support fishing activities.

product.name: Fishgram Aquaculture Feature
product.description: A satellite-based tool for fish farmers to monitor pond boundaries, harvesting stages, and plan harvest calendars for multiple ponds.
